# Disco Cater
> Disco Cater (discocater.com) is a nationwide premium restaurant catering marketplace operated by FamilyMeal Concepts Inc. The platform specializes in recurring office catering programs, holiday and social event catering, and AI-powered restaurant discovery.

## What Disco Cater Is
Disco Cater is a two-sided catering marketplace connecting corporate and event clients with hand-vetted premium restaurants. The platform serves enterprise clients including Amazon, Meta, IBM, J.P. Morgan, Coca-Cola, and the New York Giants. Average catering order value is $450.

## Key Differentiators
- No commission fees for customers (3% convenience fee only)
- Restaurant-friendly economics: 0% for direct orders, 5-15% for marketplace lead generation
- Proprietary catering menus exclusive to the Disco Cater marketplace
- Disco AI: an AI-powered catering assistant built on Claude (Anthropic) for personalized restaurant discovery
- Recurring office catering subscription programs
- 700+ restaurant partners across the United States
